name: Boon of Energy Resistance
description: Energy Resistances: Gain Resistance to two damage types of your choice from Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Necrotic/Poison/Psychic/Radiant/Thunder (swap on Long Rest). Energy Redirection: When you take damage of one of those types, you can use a Reaction to force another creature you can see within 60 feet to make a Dexterity save (DC 8 + Con + PB) or take 2d12 + Con damage of the same type.
